title: Petra and the Letters
author: Juniper Nakamura
blurb: Dominic Zhou, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
